name: session-bridge
description: Lets running Claude Code sessions message each other and hand off context, so one session can plan or audit while another builds.

autoDeliver.title: Auto-deliver peer messages
autoDeliver.description: Pass incoming peer messages to the model as they arrive. Off: hold them, notify, and read them with /bridge-inbox.

cmux.title: Use cmux features
cmux.description: Inside cmux: show the bridge in the sidebar, raise a cmux notification for a held message, name the tab after the session, and allow bridge_spawn and bridge_focus. Off: ignore cmux.
